bottleneck.description: Mid-tier Chinese L2/L2+ ADAS domain-controller and DMS supplier; competitive design-win basis, partially backed by Horizon Robotics shareholding.

dependency.key_customers: Changan Automobile, multiple Chinese OEMs for L2/L2+ ADAS, Sterling Tools (India), export-model OEMs across EU/UK/Australia/SEA/Middle East/South America
dependency.key_suppliers: SoC suppliers (incl. Horizon Journey, NXP, Mobileye, TI), camera/sensor vendors, foundry partners via fabless chip suppliers

editorial.notes: MiniEye is a credible but sub-scale Chinese ADAS supplier (Changan ADAS domain-controller win, Sterling Tools India partnership), competing directly with Horizon (which is now a strategic shareholder), Bosch, Huawei MDC, Black Sesame, Desay SV, ZF, Continental, and OEM in-house teams. Project-level switching cost exists but the broader market has many qualified suppliers, and MiniEye lacks unique IP or scale to be a sole-source bottleneck. The Horizon stake reinforces commercial linkage but does not change the structural position. Reflects a competitive mid-tier ADAS solutions market consistent with the LOW anchor for contested supplier categories.
